description.zh: 要给加密参数添加的描述信息。长度限制为200字符。
description.en: The description of the parameter. The description must be 1 to 200 characters in length.

description.zh: 参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过180字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD、OOS开头。
description.en: The name of the parameter. The name must be 1 to 180 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). It cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.
The ID of the resource group.
The value of the parameter. The value must be 1 to 4096 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos update-secret-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MySecretParameter --value update --description SecretParameter --tags k1=v1 k2=v2 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxsn4m4000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UpdateSecretParameter --region cn-hangzhou --Description SecretParameter --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxsn4m4000000' --Value update --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tags '{"k1":"v1","k2":"v2"}' --Name MySecretParameter
